name: Sonobe Yuki
source:
The protagonist's mother-in-law. She married right after graduating from school, and since she gave birth and raised her children early, she is a bit naive.

She adores her husband and has never been with another man. She has been away from her husband for a while now, but is not in the mood for a man.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_050.html#character]official site[/url]]
